title: Ghost and Border
author: Freya Quintana
blurb: Isandro Vasquez, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
